contract_tests: One-based page 1: paginate(range(1,8), 1, 2) == [1, 2] and paginate(range(1,8), 1, 3) == [1, 2, 3] — test_page_one_returns_first_size_elements
Beyond last page: paginate(range(1,8), 5, 2) == [] and paginate(range(1,8), 100, 2) == [] — test_page_beyond_last_returns_empty_list
Empty input: paginate([], 1, 2) == [] and paginate([], 2, 2) == [] — test_empty_input_returns_empty_list
Invalid page/size: paginate([1,2,3], 0, 2) == [], paginate([1,2,3], -1, 2) == [], paginate([1,2,3], 1, 0) == [], paginate([1,2,3], 1, -2) == [] — test_invalid_page_or_size_returns_empty_list
Returns list and does not mutate input: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 2, 2) == [3, 4], isinstance(result, list), items unchanged — test_returns_list_and_does_not_mutate_input

from pagination import paginate


def test_page_two_size_two_returns_third_and_fourth():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_page_one_returns_first_size_elements():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 2)
    assert result == [1, 2]
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 3) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_last_partial_page_returns_remaining_items():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 4, 2)
    assert result == [7]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_page_beyond_last_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 5, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 100, 2) == []


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([], 1, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert paginate([], 2, 2) == []


def test_invalid_page_or_size_returns_empty_list():
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 0, 2) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], -1, 2) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, 0) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, -2) == []


def test_returns_list_and_does_not_mutate_input():
    items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    snapshot = list(items)
    result = paginate(items, 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert items == snapshot

patches.rationale: The original paginate used zero-based slicing (start = page * page_size), so page=2 returned items[4:6] = [5,6] and page=4 returned items[8:10] = [] for range(1,8). The issue requires one-based page numbers: page=2, size=2 must return [3,4]. Fix: start = (page - 1) * page_size. Also return a list (not a range slice) so the return type is consistently a list, and preserve empty/invalid input behavior (page < 1 or page_size < 1 -> []). Pages beyond the last page naturally yield [] because the slice is empty. The previous attempt's failure was that page=4, size=2 gave [7] instead of [] — with one-based indexing, page 4 starts at index 6, and range(1,8) has 7 elements (indices 0..6), so items[6:8] = [7]. The issue says 'return [] beyond the last page'; page 4 with size 2 covers items 7-8, but only item 7 exists, so it is the last (partial) page, not beyond it. The correct 'beyond last page' test is page=5 (start index 8, beyond the 7 elements). I will write the regression test accordingly, using page=5 for the beyond-last-page contract, and keep page=4 as the partial last page returning [7].
